note: Prompts a real user would type. Running these needs a tracker: a GitHub repo with open and closed issues, or a configured Atlassian skill. Assertions describe what the run should demonstrate, not exact output text.

evals.expected_output: A proposed size for the issue with three estimator votes and their reasoning, written to the tracker only after the user confirms.
assertions: Runs `agent-config start size` before anything else
Reads references/size-one.md, references/poker.md and exactly one tracker file; does not read sweep.md or calibrate.md unless reference stories are missing
Launches three estimator subagents (developer, tester, risk) in parallel, none of whose briefs contain another estimator's vote
The proposed size is a value on config.scale
Asks for confirmation listing the exact write before running any tracker write command

evals.prompt: go through the backlog and size everything that isn't pointed yet, I want to know what's not ready for sprint planning
evals.expected_output: A report table of at most sweep.max stories with size, confidence, refinement needs and any split proposals, followed by one confirmation for all writes.
assertions: Reads references/sweep.md and references/poker.md, not calibrate.md (unless reference stories are missing)
Fetches at most sweep.max + 1 stories and says how many remain when there are more
Every row has a size, including low-confidence rows, with what is missing listed
Stories at or above the split threshold get a split into vertical slices, each child sized
Asks one confirmation covering every size and every child story before writing

evals.prompt: our reference stories are getting old, recalibrate them
evals.expected_output: A proposal table of one closed story per scale value with a one-line reason, gaps named, and the confirmed set written to the repo layer.
assertions: Reads references/calibrate.md and the tracker file only
Summarises closed stories through batch subagents rather than reading every story into the main session
Reports scale values with no fitting story as gaps instead of stretching a story to fill them
Writes referenceStories with calibratedAt through `agent-config write size --layer repo`, merged into the existing layer, after confirmation
Tells the user which file to commit

evals.prompt: can we switch to t-shirt sizes instead of fibonacci?
evals.expected_output: The scale changed to ordered labels in the repo layer, followed by a recalibration against the new scale.
assertions: Writes scale as an ordered label list (e.g. ["XS","S","M","L","XL"]) to the repo layer, preserving the layer's other keys
Starts calibration against the new scale
Leaves sizes already on tickets untouched
Does not edit config files with a file tool

evals.expected_output: In a repo with no reference stories yet, a calibration first, then the estimate.
assertions: Notices that referenceStories is empty and says in one line that it calibrates first
Picks Jira because the Atlassian skill reports ready, or asks when it does not
Finds the Story Points field and asks before saving it as the Atlassian skill's fields.points
Proceeds to single sizing of PROJ-7 after calibration is confirmed
